title: P0 Docking Validation Benchmark
description: Validation benchmark: re-dock a known co-crystal ligand into its binding site and compute RMSD for pose quality assessment.

pdb_id.description: PDB ID of the co-crystal structure. Structure will be fetched from RCSB.

ligand_smiles.description: SMILES of the ligand to re-dock (nirmatrelvir default for 7RFS).

box_center.description: Docking grid center [x, y, z] in Å (from co-crystal ligand centroid).

box_size.description: Docking box dimensions [x, y, z] in Å.

rmsd_threshold.description: RMSD cutoff (Å) for a pose to be considered a correct re-dock. < 2 Å is the standard criterion.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved.
